user.title: Connect to MuPiBox
user.description: Connect Home Assistant to the local MuPiBox API. The admin password is optional and is only needed for protected maintenance actions such as rescan, restart, reboot and power off.

data_description.host: Hostname or IP address without http:// or https://.
data_description.port: MuPiBox listens on port 8090 by default.
data_description.use_ssl: Enable only when MuPiBox is reached through an HTTPS reverse proxy.
data_description.admin_password: Leave empty if no admin password is configured or if Home Assistant should only use public player/status functions.
data_description.connection_type: Legacy NG or secure common API v1 for Classic/NG.

zeroconf_confirm.title: Discovered MuPiBox
zeroconf_confirm.description: Home Assistant discovered {name} on your local network. Confirm to add it. The admin password is optional and only enables protected maintenance actions.

data_description.admin_password: Leave empty for normal player, TTS and status functions. Enter it if protected maintenance actions should also be available.

v1_trust.title: Verify box certificate
v1_trust.description: Compare the SHA-256 SPKI fingerprint with the trusted local display of {name}. Enter the exact fingerprint shown on the box; do not blindly trust the network.

v1_start.title: Enable pairing on the box
v1_start.description: Sign in to MuPiBox Admin and click 'Home Assistant sicher koppeln' under Smart Home. Then return and continue within 60 seconds.

v1_confirm.title: Enter display pairing code
v1_confirm.description: Enter the six-digit code shown on {name}; it expires after five minutes.

error.invalid_auth: The MuPiBox admin password is invalid.
error.unknown: Unexpected error while connecting to MuPiBox.
error.invalid_fingerprint: The fingerprint does not match the box.
error.pairing_not_enabled: Pairing was not enabled or failed. Enable it again on the box.

abort.invalid_discovery: The discovered service could not be verified as this MuPiBox.
abort.classic_pairing_not_supported: Classic was discovered but pairing is not supported yet. Existing NG installations remain unchanged.
